I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message. The latest date posted there for the Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, but I told him to confirm it with Ilse before updating the account sheet.

There are two dates in that channel. On 14 Oct Ilse posted 25 November. A later bot message in the same thread says she corrected it to 10 June because she'd read the wrong line. Ilse never posted the correction herself, and I can't see where it came from. I also found no Brackenwater contract in the share to check either date against.
